context.why: Stories 1 to 3 are accepted. fairdm/core/editing.py holds RecordEditingPage, EditDetails, EditDescriptions, EditKeyDates, EditIdentifiers, DeleteRecord and manage_menu, registered on Project, Dataset, Sample and Measurement with menu=False, and <c-actions.manage> draws the menu on all four overviews. tests/test_core/test_editing.py holds the tests and fixtures. This last story adds the keywords page on all four record types, repairs KeywordForm so the page can open at all, and removes the sample's old Keywords page and its generic base. It also closes the menu: all six entries, in one order, on every record type.
plan_sections: D4 (the paragraph on the crispy helper)
prior_decisions: decisions.md planning decision D4 (the keywords form is repaired to a working state, not redesigned) and D8 onward, which describe the module as it stands.

KeywordForm is in fairdm/contrib/generic/forms.py around lines 148-238. Today it raises for every sample type: it calls get_setting(<MODELNAME>, 'keywords'), which is getattr(settings, 'FAIRDM_ROCKSAMPLE') with no default (fairdm/utils/utils.py:33-44). It reads FAIRDM_DATASET['keyword_vocabularies'] for datasets and FAIRDM_<MODELNAME>['keywords'] otherwise. It also assigns KeywordForm._meta.model on every instantiation. Repair: read the vocabularies configured for the record's core model (RecordAccess(record).model, so RockSample reads the Sample setting) with a default of none when the setting or the key is absent, and stop writing to the shared _meta. Keep the two existing setting names and shapes; add no new setting. What the form offers and how it saves is otherwise unchanged.
The sample's old Keywords page raises ImproperlyConfigured on its own (no model or queryset). The shared page avoids that through RecordEditingPage.get_object().

KeywordForm sets a crispy FormHelper with a form_id and no form_tag = False. Treat its helper as EditDetails treats one (plan D4): form_tag False and no inputs, so django-mvp's form element and Save buttons are the only ones. If EditDetails has a helper-reset function, reuse it; do not write a second.

Every record has `keywords` (many-to-many to research_vocabs.Concept) and `tags` (TaggableManager) from BaseModel (fairdm/core/abstract.py:42-48). The page test for a record type with no vocabulary configured uses the free-text tags field.

The sample template still passes an Edit keywords item through the Manage menu's slot, where it is drawn after Delete (decisions D20). Remove that item when manage_menu lists the shared page. The fixed order is: edit details, descriptions, keywords, key dates, identifiers, divider, delete. After this story no record template passes anything through the slot unless it is something other than these six.
fairdm/core/sample/plugins.py: the heading_config description on the old sample Keywords page talks about key dates. It goes with the page.
The readiness checklists of the project and dataset overviews have a keywords item with no address today; it now carries the keywords page's address.
docs/user-guide/project/about.md and docs/user-guide/dataset/about.md still say Edit details covers dates and identifiers; correct that sentence in T012 while you are in the user guide.

acceptance.given_when_then: Given the test classes tasks.md T010 lists, when they are run before T011, then they fail because the shared keywords page does not exist and KeywordForm raises.

Given a project, a dataset, a demo sample type and a demo measurement type, when someone at each level requests and submits the keywords page and opens each overview, then every outcome in tasks.md T010 holds, all 24 page and record type combinations are offered to a manage-level person in one order, and the sample's old keywords page is gone.
Given the documentation, when it is read, then record-editing-pages.md covers all six pages and says the keywords page is to be replaced by #298.
